description_en: Disables specific cloud computers in a cloud computer share. After you call this operation to disable specific cloud computers, they enter the unavailable state
description_zh: 禁用共享型云电脑中的云电脑。禁用后，云电脑的状态变为unavailable
kebab_example: aliyun ecd disable-desktops-in-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-group-id dg-2i8qxpv6t1a030000 --desktop-ids ecd-84mztzatmipf20000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisableDesktopsInGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the list of regions where Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise is available

parameters.name: desktop_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the cloud computers
